channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran-backed Houthis seize strategic Mayun Island: Can they hold it?
item.description: The takeover solidifies the group's position in the Bab al-Mandeb, but holding it long-term could be difficult.

item.title: ‘Divine triumph’: Iran celebrates Houthis’ capture of Yemen’s Red Sea coast
item.description: Iranian officials have praised the Houthis' victories but have not spoken about any imminent closure of Bab al-Mandeb.

item.title: Yemen government forces say Houthi ‘members, vehicles’ targeted in Mocha
item.description: Yemeni government forces says they launched air strikes on Houthi fighters along the Red Sea coast.

item.title: Houthis celebrate seizing control of Yemen’s Red Sea coast
item.description: Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis have been celebrating after seizing control of the Red Sea coast in a rapid offensive.

item.title: Saudi Arabia shuts critical oil pipeline after drone attack: What it means
item.description: Baghdad launches investigation, closes border after confirming strike came from Iraqi territory.

item.title: Fighting re-erupts in Yemen and civilians are paying the price
item.description: More than 900 people have been killed or injured and at least 5,000 families have fled their homes in less than a week.

item.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
item.description: Iraq removes a military commander and opens investigations into the attack that came from an area bordering Iran.

item.title: Grammy-winning US rapper Lil Durk acquitted in murder-for-hire trial
item.description: The Chicago rapper was arrested in 2024 and accused of involvement in a shooting that killed the cousin of rival rapper Quando Rondo.

item.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
item.description: The Iran-backed Houthis are also reported to have seized Perim - a strategic island on the major shipping route.
